# Bundled Licenses

<!-- generated by src/core/licenses/gen_licenses_c.py --mode table — 手編集禁止。
     各 licenses/manifest.json を編集して再生成する。 -->

This table lists the third-party components included in the distribution: 35 in the engine, 19 in plugins, and 3 fonts (7 of them depend on the build configuration).

The source of truth is each `licenses/manifest.json`; the mechanism is described in `src/core/doc/LicenseSystem.md`. The full license texts are included in the `licenses/` folder of the distribution.

## Engine

Components built into the engine executable and written out to `licenses/` by `make install`.

### Engine Foundation

| Component | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Kirikiri Z | Equivalent to BSD-3-Clause | Original text in Japanese. Includes a clause prohibiting use of the name for promotion |
| zlib | Zlib |  |
| libpng | libpng (PNG Ref Lib v2) |  |
| libjpeg-turbo | IJG + BSD-3-Clause | A combination of multiple licenses |
| Oniguruma | BSD-2-Clause |  |
| GLM | MIT |  |
| plog | MIT |  |
| icline | MIT |  |
| Brotli | MIT |  |
| bzip2 | bzip2 (BSD-style) |  |
| liblzma (XZ Utils) | 0BSD | Only the liblzma part is used (the GPL of the CLI tools does not apply) |

### Platform

| Component | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| SDL3 | Zlib | SDL variants only |
| glad | WTFPL / CC0-1.0 + Apache-2.0 | Terms differ between the generated code and the Khronos specifications |
| ANGLE | BSD-3-Clause | **Only when `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_ANGLE` is enabled** / Required for configurations that bundle libEGL / libGLESv2. No build currently bundles them, so nothing defines the macro |
| D3DCompiler | Microsoft redistributable | **Only when `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_D3DCOMPILER` is enabled** / Not OSS. A redistributable component of the Windows SDK. Only for the WIN variant, which links directly to d3dcompiler |
| SDL_GameControllerDB | Zlib |  |
| appserve | MIT | **Only when `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_APPSERVE` is enabled** / Local HTTP server that serves the engine settings page (-userconf). Only with KRKRZ_USERCONF_WEB (desktop) |

## Plugins

Each plugin DLL registers these at runtime (they are merged into `System.getLicenseList()` / `-license`). At install time, the original texts are also written to `licenses/plugins/` in the distribution (only for the plugins actually built).

| Plugin | Component | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| clipfile | clipparse | MIT | A Kirikiri-independent library that parses and writes .clip files |
| clipfile | SQLite | Public domain | Built in (amalgamation) so clipparse can read the metadata database inside .clip files |
| expat | expat | MIT |  |
| krkr_richtext | richtext | MIT |  |
| krkr_richtext | minikin | Apache-2.0 | Line breaking, derived from Android |
| krkreffekseer | Effekseer | MIT |  |
| krkreffekseer | minizip-ng | Zlib |  |
| krkrlive2d | Live2D Cubism Core | Live2D Proprietary Software License | Not OSS. Requires a separate agreement and the prescribed credit notice |
| krkrthreepp | threepp | MIT | A C++ port of three.js |
| krkrthreepp | VRM (Kota Iguchi) | MIT |  |
| layerExImage | CxImage | Zlib-style (CxImage-specific terms) | Reuses part of the image processing code (xImaDsp) |
| layerExSave | LodePNG | Zlib | Used for PNG saving in Layer.saveLayerImagePng and related methods (version 20161127) |
| layerExVector | ThorVG | MIT |  |
| layerExVector | JerryScript | Apache-2.0 | **Only when `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_LOTTIE` is enabled** / For evaluating Lottie Expressions |
| layerExVector | RapidJSON | MIT | **Only when `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_LOTTIE` is enabled** / For the Lottie parser |
| minizip | minizip-ng | Zlib |  |
| psdfile | psdparse | MIT |  |
| sigcheck | LibTomCrypt | Public domain / WTFPL (dual) | Used for signature verification (RSA / hashes) |
| sigcheck | LibTomMath | Unlicense (public domain) | Multi-precision arithmetic backend for LibTomCrypt |

## Other (Fonts and Data)

These are data rather than code, but since they ship in the distribution, they are handled in the same list. If a title adds its own fonts, put the license in **`licenses/*.txt` on the game data side** instead of a manifest, and it is merged in at runtime.

| Component | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Noto Fonts | OFL-1.1 |  |
| Roboto | Apache-2.0 |  |
| elements_basic (fontello icons) | OFL-1.1 | Four sets: Font Awesome / Entypo / Elusive / Iconic |
| Added by each title | Per title | `<data>/licenses/*.txt` is enumerated at runtime |

## Configuration-Dependent Entries

Depending on the build configuration, these components are not compiled at all. In configurations where the macro is not defined, they appear neither in the built-in table nor in the distribution.

| Macro | Target |
|---|---|
| `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_ANGLE` | ANGLE |
| `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_APPSERVE` | appserve |
| `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_D3DCOMPILER` | D3DCompiler |
| `TVP_LICENSE_WITH_LOTTIE` | JerryScript / RapidJSON |
